docs.description: Phrases to type in turn, each erased before the next, as a JSON array of strings. Without it, the element's own text is typed once.
With phrases: start over after the last one, for as long as the element is on screen.
Text in front of the typed text that is there from the start, e.g. "$ ".
The cursor's shape. It blinks while it waits.
Average milliseconds between two characters: lower types faster. Each varies a little, like a person typing; erasing takes half as long.
Milliseconds before the first character, counted from when the element comes into view.
With phrases: milliseconds a typed phrase stays before it is erased.

events.name: sb-typed
events.description: When a phrase is fully typed. detail: { text, index }.
